question:
Let \(a_0\) and \(b_0\) be any two positive integers. Define \(a_n,b_n\) for \(n\ge1\) using the relations
\[
a_n=a_{n-1}+2b_{n-1},\qquad b_n=a_{n-1}+b_{n-1}
\]
and let \(c_n=\frac{a_n}{b_n}\), for \(n=0,1,2,\ldots\).

(a) Write \((\sqrt2-c_{n+1})\) in terms of \((\sqrt2-c_n)\).

(b) Show that \(|\sqrt2-c_{n+1}|<\frac1{1+\sqrt2}|\sqrt2-c_n|\).

(c) Show that \(\lim_{n\to\infty}c_n=\sqrt2\).

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
